title: Port command activity publication and live listener ordering
scope: Command-driven start/progress/clear patches of useCommandActivity, commandRunning, snapshot identity and live synchronous subscriptions. Preserve publication before listener callbacks, latest-state versus fixed previous-state arguments, callback identity/reentrancy/errors. Arbitrary Zustand partial functions/replace/host mutation excluded; full guarded/interrupt and native runtime integration remain separate.
acceptance: Pinned complete activity module and actual installed Zustand reference compare full state, snapshot identities, running payload identities, listener order, unsubscribe/re-add, reentrant publication and exact faults on independent inputs.

Typed patch API preserves null versus empty and raw clock bits/UTF16. Native visit/depth/slot limits report separate errors without source fault normalization; native/Wasm and all existing suites remain required.
open_items: Implement and capture original-first fixed cases; full guarded/interrupt/native owner/browser integration remains open.
